description: One very wide thin horizontal drifting water-mist wisp, broken low flowing pale cyan-white cloud wisps, sparse and airy with transparent gaps, only a narrow low ribbon of fog, no dense wall and no scenery. No dark outline. Isolated static environment sprite for a cozy crisp 16-bit pixel art mobile fishing game with turquoise tiled ruins. Clear square pixel clusters, three or four shades per color, readable at native size, no anti-aliased blur, no glow, no background, no tile or ground, no scenery, no letters or UI, no motion trails, no sprite sheet. Keep the entire object inside canvas with transparent margins.
